# skycloak_cluster_maintenance_window (Resource)

The cluster's own maintenance window: when Skycloak applies upgrades and other disruptive changes. A singleton per cluster (create == update upsert). Destroying this resource does not leave the cluster without a window: it reverts the cluster to the workspace default window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_cluster_maintenance_window" "production" {
  cluster_id   = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  enabled      = true
  days_of_week = [2, 4] # Tuesday and Thursday
  start_local  = "02:00"
  end_local    = "05:00"
  timezone     = "Europe/Berlin"
}

# Destroying this resource reverts the cluster to the workspace default
# window; a managed cluster always has an effective maintenance window.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `days_of_week` (List of Number) Days of week the window applies to (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the window is active.
- `end_local` (String) Local end time, `HH:MM`.
- `start_local` (String) Local start time, `HH:MM`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/maintenance-window`.
